metaTitle: Cook Services in Chennai & Thoraipakkam | Home Cooks | {{name}}
metaDescription: Reliable cook services in Chennai, Okkiyam Thoraipakkam, and OMR. Skilled home cooks for daily family meals, vegetarian dishes, traditional South Indian and North Indian cooking.
eyebrowText: Home Cook · Part-time & Live-in · OMR & Chennai
heroSubtitle: A home cook who learns your family's sambar, your oil limits, your 8am tiffin — and keeps the kitchen running whether you're home or not. Tell us your area and shift on WhatsApp; you'll usually hear back {{responseTime}}.
whoIsItFor: Both of you leave for work by 8am and the dinner question is still open at 6pm.
Your toddler needs a fixed 7pm dinner and you're stuck in OMR traffic until 8.
Your parents live with you, but standing at the stove for two meals a day is getting harder for them.
You've just moved into a flat on the corridor and the kitchen still feels like a hotel-kitchen problem.
Weekends mean guests — and cooking for ten on top of a full working week isn't sustainable.
availableWorkers: Whoever is placed with you cooks in private home kitchens, not canteens or events. They work to your recipes and your spice level, adapt to low-oil or no-onion instructions without fuss, and clean the cooking area before they leave. You'll see their experience and locality on each profile before you talk to them.
scopeIncluded: Breakfast — idli, dosa, upma, poori, parathas, filter coffee, your morning tiffin routine
Lunch — rice, sambar, rasam, kootu, poriyal, dal, chapatis and fresh curries
Dinner — lighter family meals: phulkas, subzis, khichdi, soups
Vegetable washing, peeling, chopping, and fresh masala or batter preparation
Cleaning the stove, countertops and cooking vessels after the meal
Telling you what's running low so next week's menu isn't a surprise
scopeExcluded: Groceries and vegetables — you buy them, or send a list and someone picks them up
The menu decision — you set it, and they cook to it
Cooking vessels and storage containers — these stay yours
Heavy kitchen deep-cleaning and fridge defrosting

disclaimer: Cook services are provided as private home assistance for domestic meal preparation. Menu planning, ingredients, and cooking vessels are provided by the client household.

unaskedQAs.question: Will she cook her food or ours?
unaskedQAs.answer: Yours. The first few days are your recipes: you show the sambar, the spice level, the oil limit. Cooks are hired to follow your kitchen's way, not theirs.

unaskedQAs.question: What happens if we're travelling for a week?
unaskedQAs.answer: Tell us in advance. Planned absences are easier to cover with notice — replacement support is available where possible, but a week's warning helps far more than a day's.

unaskedQAs.question: Can she cook for guests or a small function at home?
unaskedQAs.answer: Say so before you confirm the shift. Extra-quantity cooking works when it's part of the agreement from day one, not an assumption later.

unaskedQAs.question: My father's doctor has put him on a no-salt diet. Is that followed?
unaskedQAs.answer: Medical diets are followed exactly as written. Give the instructions in writing if it helps — low-oil, no-onion and diabetic-friendly meals are routine asks.

unaskedQAs.question: Do I have to be home while she cooks?
unaskedQAs.answer: No. Most families hand over the kitchen and leave for work. Trust is built on the profile, the introduction and the first week — not on you standing in the kitchen.

unaskedQAs.question: What languages will she speak with my mother?
unaskedQAs.answer: Tell us your language preference in the first message — you'll see it on each profile, and your mother will meet her before anything is confirmed.

unaskedQAs.question: Can the same person also do evening snack prep?
unaskedQAs.answer: Duties are what you agree. If the shift includes evening prep, say so — the scope is set before she starts, not renegotiated daily.

faqs.question: How can I book a home cook in Chennai through {{name}}?
faqs.answer: Message on WhatsApp with your locality, which meals you need (breakfast, lunch or dinner), and your shift preference. You'll hear back {{responseTime}} with matching cooks, and the next step is an introduction — you talk to the person before deciding.

faqs.question: Do you provide cook services in Okkiyam Thoraipakkam and OMR?
faqs.answer: Yes. Morning and evening shifts along OMR — Perungudi, Sholinganallur, Karapakkam, Thoraipakkam — are the most requested. Message your exact apartment or street and we'll confirm coverage immediately.

faqs.question: Can the cook prepare both South Indian and North Indian food?
faqs.answer: Many cooks are strong in South Indian home-style meals — tiffins, sambar, rasam, poriyal — and several also make North Indian rotis, dals and subzis. State your cuisine in the first message so the profiles you see actually match.

faqs.question: Are live-in (full-time) and part-time cooks available?
faqs.answer: Both. Part-time covers one meal block, full-day covers all meals, and live-in cooks stay in your home with structured hours and rest — not 24 hours on call.

faqs.question: What hygiene practices do the cooks follow?
faqs.answer: Handwashing before cooking, vegetables washed properly, the stove and counters wiped down after the meal, vessels cleaned. If your household has specific rules — separate knives, no onion on certain days — say them on day one.

faqs.question: What happens if our assigned cook needs to take leave?
faqs.answer: Tell us as soon as you know. With notice, we look for cover or replacement support; sudden multi-day absences are harder, which is why leave expectations are agreed before the placement starts.
